what_it_is: Lockheed Martin C-130J Super Hercules is listed in this atlas as a tactical medium transport special ops (in_production). The atlas legacy record attributes it to Lockheed Martin Aeronautics (Marietta, Georgia, USA). Indian Tier-1 manufacturing of structural sub-assemblies (empennage, centre fuselage) at TLMAL Hyderabad — L2 for those sub-assemblies. Engine, avionics, mission systems, FADEC, final assembly all imported (L0).
